title: Genre Switch · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Genre Switch · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a harmless everyday event and a genre such as mystery or comedy. The lead retells the event as a short story in that genre. The others can identify both the event and intended genre. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Genre Switch, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The others can identify both the event and intended genre.
recall.why: The others can identify both the event and intended genre.
